n142a74dae9.headline: Africa loses $15bn annually due to climate change — AfDB president - QUICK NEWS AFRICA
n142a74dae9.summary: AfDB president Akinwumi Adesina says Africa loses between $7 billion and $15 billion annually due to climate change. He made the remarks in an interview with the BBC.
n142a74dae9.why: The African Development Bank is a multilateral lender financing infrastructure and development across the African continent.

neb8657fa69.headline: Seat boss quits chairmanship of automobile employers' association due to government's lack of commitment to electric cars: "They are not up to the task"
neb8657fa69.summary: Wayne Griffiths, president of Cupra and Seat, has resigned as president of the car manufacturers' association ANFAC. He said the government lacks commitment to electric cars.
neb8657fa69.why: ANFAC is the Spanish automobile manufacturers' association, and Spain is a major car production hub for European carmakers.

n4f899b657c.headline: EPH leads the rises; goes down CY4Gate
n4f899b657c.summary: EPH gained 18 percent to EUR0.17 per share, leading Milan's small-cap index on Friday afternoon, while CY4Gate was among the decliners. The report lists best and worst performers.
n4f899b657c.why: Piazza Affari is the Borsa Italiana exchange in Milan, and its small-cap segment groups smaller listed Italian companies whose moves reflect local investor sentiment.

n5432883df1.headline: Maloney in $200M double deal finances Hyatt, Rock Hard cement expansion
n5432883df1.summary: Construction of a new Hyatt hotel in Barbados is set to begin this year, with the hotel opening by 2026. Maloney has arranged $200 million in double financing for the Hyatt and Rock Hard cement expansion.
n5432883df1.why: Large hotel and cement projects are capital-intensive, and their financing reflects investment activity in Caribbean tourism and construction.

n29a9f959c1.headline: Microsoft: Microsoft to invest $7.16 billion in new data centres in northeastern Spain
n29a9f959c1.summary: Microsoft plans to invest 6.69 billion euros, about $7.16 billion, to develop data centres in Zaragoza, Aragon, a major European cloud computing hub.
n29a9f959c1.why: Microsoft is a US technology company whose cloud and AI infrastructure investments shape demand for data centre capacity, power and construction.

impacts.name: Microsoft
impacts.why: The company is committing capital to build new data centres in Spain.

n9c5cf99d5b.headline: Helios Towers targets expanded rural connectivity
n9c5cf99d5b.summary: Telecom tower operator Helios Towers aims to extend coverage to an additional 20 million people by 2026, focusing on rural connectivity. The ambition was reported by ITWeb.
n9c5cf99d5b.why: Helios Towers owns and operates mobile telecom towers across Africa, and its growth depends on mobile operator demand for network coverage.

n3a533223a0.headline: Insured Flood Losses in Germany Could Range From US$2.1B to US$3.2B: Moody's RMS
n3a533223a0.summary: Moody's RMS said insured losses from floods in Central Europe between May 30 and June 3 will likely fall within EUR2 billion to EUR3 billion, with Germany affected.
n3a533223a0.why: Insured catastrophe losses affect reinsurers and primary insurers, and they can influence pricing and capital needs across the insurance sector.

n5c4c1ef6d1.headline: TSX futures slip as US Fed rate concerns linger
n5c4c1ef6d1.summary: Futures tied to Canada's main stock index fell on Friday amid investor concerns about the US Federal Reserve keeping interest rates elevated for longer. S&P/TSX futures dipped 0.65%.
n5c4c1ef6d1.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, and US interest rate expectations influence global equity valuations.

n9c7b5046c7.headline: EC finalises new tariffs on Chinese EV imports: taxes set to rise from 10% to around 25%
n9c7b5046c7.summary: The European Commission is finalising new tariffs on Chinese EV imports after a lengthy investigation into state subsidies. Taxes are set to rise from 10% to around 25%.
n9c7b5046c7.why: Tariffs on Chinese EVs affect the cost of imports into the EU and the competitive position of European carmakers against low-cost Chinese producers.
n9c7b5046c7.why_moved: The tariff increase is a direct trade measure against Chinese EV imports, changing the cost of selling those vehicles in the EU.

nd1ed45942b.headline: Investors Continue to Punish French Assets in Run-Up to Snap Elections
nd1ed45942b.summary: French assets remain under pressure as markets prepare for snap elections at the end of the month. Investors are pricing in the prospect of a win by Marine Le Pen's National Rally party.
nd1ed45942b.why: Snap elections and the policy direction of a new government shape French equity, bond and currency markets.
nd1ed45942b.why_moved: Investors are selling French assets in anticipation of snap elections, with the prospect of a National Rally victory cited in the report.

ne396e50bcf.headline: Dollar today: official, blue, MEP, CCL, and Crypto rates on Friday, June 14
ne396e50bcf.summary: Argentina's official, blue, MEP, CCL, and crypto dollar exchange rates illustrate the complexity and segmentation of the country's currency market.
ne396e50bcf.why: Multiple exchange rates indicate capital controls and economic challenges, affecting foreign investment and inflation expectations.
ne396e50bcf.why_moved: The existence of multiple dollar exchange rates signals ongoing currency controls and economic instability, influencing investor behavior and market pricing.

nb83a599ba7.why: Humanitarian aid impacts regional stability and U.S. foreign policy, influencing markets related to commodities and geopolitics.

n0614a0f735.summary: Prime Minister Sunak will announce funding to support clean energy and artificial intelligence development at the G7 summit.

n3b1a0d14c5.headline: Evergrande liquidation law firm probing PwC, others for potential claims: Sources
n3b1a0d14c5.summary: A law firm handling China Evergrande Group’s liquidation is investigating PwC and other parties for potential claims.

na11feac493.why: Fuel price changes impact inflation and consumer spending in Malaysia's economy.

naed31115a0.summary: India's merchandise exports increased by 9.1% in May, reaching $38.13 billion, supported by higher shipments of electronic goods and other products.
